participation in the DPM Type-2 Diabetes mellitus in Westphalie-Lippe (Curaplan) has positive effects for the participants, in that they experience a reduction in anxiety and a strengthening of their self-confidence.

the question of whether and how the subjective experience of positive participation can be described and explained.
the question of how the subjective effects of a DMP program for Type-2 Diabetes can be described in a meaningful and comprehensive way.
